title: Quality indexes Q9: a replay harness that runs one phase k times on a frozen item, for pass^k
summary: Production data cannot give pass^k: no item ships twice, because a ship consumes it. Of 17 items with two or more tries, 13 shipped at last. pass^k per item is C(c,k)/C(n,k), averaged over items (tau-bench). Spec: docs/architecture/llm-quality-indexes.md §8 PQ2. Needs evolve agent run (ADR-0152), which is on main.
fix: A fixed replay set in config (proposal: 10 items from the last 30 days, 5 shipped and 5 failed, frozen at their base commits). Run one phase k times per item through evolve agent run (ADR-0152), record pass or fail, and emit PQ2 for k = 1, 2, 4 with a cluster bootstrap by item at --scope replay.
acceptance: RED first: 3 tries with 2 passes give pass^1 = 2/3 and pass^2 = 1/3
The harness uses a fake runner seam in tests and never launches a real LLM CLI
The replay set is read only from policy; a test shows that the harness has no write path to it
